value.rationale: Deleting a parallel class from a canonical finite design changes the complete-affine incidence Rips filtration qualitatively, creating two distinct groups of r2 spheres and a nontrivial, exponentially large r3 wedge where the full affine plane is contractible. It yields a natural parameter-uniform integral homotopy and persistence theorem for all existing affine planes, including the named Pappus graph, not a small isolated table or routine numerical improvement.
